[[File:Drixar.jpg|thumb|Drixar on Bothawui]]
'''Drixar''' was a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] for a criminal organization that operated in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. He masqueraded as a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].

Thanks to his cover, Drixar was not only assisting [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] that profited his syndicate, but also monitored all kinds of important activities. 

Like many spies and undercover agents on Bothawui, he used to socialize with other spies of rival factions; framed within a social and "friendly" relationship with them, he regularly met with [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] operative [[Sharalon]], and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative [[Garin]] at the [[Cedrian Terrace]]. During their feigned and superficial chatter, each one tried to pull out some slipped piece of information; although Sharanon and Garin had understood Drixar's role, they couldn't find out his employer.

The two men pretended to be close; Garin slapped Drixar on the back, and the Wroonian shook their hands vigorously. During drink he boasted with big tales. At one point he mentioned [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and advanced [[computer/Legends|computer]] equipment heading for [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], about which Sharalon and Garin knew nothing. He also learned that Garin's "[[Rebel safehouse|office]]" had a recent computer upgrade.

That evening, a saboteur that perhaps worked for Drixar, caused a crash to the new comm surveillance system of the Rebel front-house.
